title:
—How much is the clock fast now?
 
 His mother straightened the battered alarm clock that was lying on its side in the middle of the mantelpiece until its dial showed a quarter to twelve and then laid it once more on its side.
 
 —An hour and twenty-five minutes, she said.
html_source:
This is another instance that shows the Dedalus family’s further descent into poverty, as they have a “battered” clock which is “an hour and twenty-five minutes” ahead of actual time.

This business with the clock has also been a problem for some time now, as Stephen asks how fast is it now.
